subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` plus `computerUseProviderMetadata` as the public metadata-only Computer Use manifest contract with this field shape and permission semantics?
rationale: The change is additive, but it freezes plugin-author API surface and is intended to inform host decisions around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Accept after docs and boundary confirmation
options.body: Complete the generated docs and merge only after owners confirm host code will use this metadata as pre-runtime discovery rather than authorization.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the fields, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before publishing the plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep the work draft or close the landing candidate until the macOS host binding model is settled enough to publish this surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs and boundary confirmation
recommendation.body: Complete the generated docs and merge only after owners confirm host code will use this metadata as pre-runtime discovery rather than authorization.
